_comment: The guide backlog, in intent order. One topic per entry.
Deliberately finite. There is not an unlimited supply of high-intent SOC 2
topics for a Security-only readiness product, and publishing past the end of
this list means publishing filler. Google's scaled content abuse policy
targets mass-produced pages regardless of who wrote them, so the backlog
running out is information, not a problem to route around.
Re-order this from Search Console impressions whenever there is real data.
`soc-2-password-requirements` came from exactly that and is one of the
Run ./scripts/next-topic.py to see what is next and generate a spec skeleton.
